description: This file defines a base class for strategies that detect when a user starts speaking in a turn-based interaction system. It includes data structures for parameters emitted at turn start, event handling methods, and lifecycle management for the strategy.

classes.name: UserTurnStartedParams
classes.description: Data class representing parameters emitted when a user turn starts, indicating whether interruptions and user speaking frames are enabled.

classes.name: BaseUserTurnStartStrategy
classes.description: Abstract base class for strategies that determine when a user starts speaking, providing event handling, lifecycle methods, and configuration options.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with options for interruptions and user speaking frames, and registers event handlers.

methods.name: task_manager
methods.description: Property that returns the configured task manager, raises error if not set.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Associates a task manager with the strategy.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Placeholder for processing incoming frames to detect user turn start.

methods.name: push_frame
methods.description: Emits an event to push a frame downstream.

methods.name: broadcast_frame
methods.description: Emits an event to broadcast a frame of a specified class.

methods.name: trigger_user_turn_started
methods.description: Triggers the event indicating a user turn has started, passing relevant parameters.
